## [1.6.0](https://github.com/ggYasin/ggyasin-morphe-patches/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-09-27)

### ✨ New Features

* support Offline Games 3.15.3 ARM64 ([6f1811c](https://github.com/ggYasin/ggyasin-morphe-patches/commit/6f1811cab2c06dd419aeaf5313ee0276bda8a539))

patches.name: Fast Offline Games startup
patches.description: Stops the loading screen waiting for Firebase/Remote Config and country lookup, and initializes ads in the background. Network requests may continue after startup.

patches.name: In-house ad not clickable
patches.description: Stops the in-house ad from opening the Play Store when tapped, so an accidental click does not leave the game. The ad and its close button are otherwise unchanged.

patches.name: In-house ad only
patches.description: Stops Offline Games from requesting rewarded ads, so the game always falls back to its own in-house ad. Banners and interstitials are untouched.

patches.name: Instant in-house ad close
patches.description: Shows the house-ad close button on opening, hides the countdown, and initializes its counter as complete. Loads patched native code for mounted installs.

patches.name: Deactivate Firebase Analytics (9GAG 8.23.0)
patches.description: Optional: disables Firebase Analytics collection using its documented manifest setting. Does not remove Firebase services.

patches.name: Remove 9GAG ads, promoted posts and trackers (8.23.0)
patches.description: Disables ad gates and bottom-banner initialization, filters promoted feed posts, and blocks listed ad/tracking hosts.

patches.name: Expanded OTP detection
patches.description: Extends ZenSMS's original OTP extractor with universal and Persian patterns.

patches.name: RTL SMS lists
patches.description: Adds RTL conversation rows while keeping conversation titles left to right.

patches.name: enable premium state
patches.description: Makes synchronous and reactive premium checks report true.
